scientific_integrity: A fully specified unconstrained, Bernoulli-interpolated, diagonal quadratic model with the exact original sampled-gradient-difference update; proof is analytic, not inferred from finite simulation.
scientific_limitations: No result for generic nonseparable stochastic interpolation, additive noise, or coupled Hessians; random terminal rates need not imply expectation rates. Historical-priority review is not independent.
title: Finite variation memory and pathwise linear convergence of AdaGrad-Diff under Bernoulli interpolation
